description: Returns opportunities FundingLandscape added recently: in the last N days (days, default 7) or since an ISO 8601 time (since). Optional query, status, source, category and minimum quality narrow the list. The response includes newSince (count, and the newest and oldest added times, usable as the next since value) and windowCoverage (how complete the page is). With no query, the list is sampled across sources and ordered by date added, newest at the top. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

category.description: A category from the dataset category list, for example Grant, Construction or Research.

compact.description: Whether results are compact (default: true); false returns full details.

days.description: Ingest-freshness window in days (default: 7). Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, not the opportunity posted date or deadline. Ignored if since is set.

limit.description: Results per page (default 15, maximum 25). Large results produce smaller pages; nextCursor continues to the next page even after a short page.

min_quality.description: Minimum record-completeness tier (default: medium). any removes this quality-tier filter; relevance, access and other filters still apply.

query.description: Optional natural language filter (e.g. "clean energy nonprofit"). Without it, the answer is a recency digest across all new opportunities.

since.description: Stateless alternative to days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at or after this instant. The newSince.newest of a previous response is a valid value, which gives a stateless watermark.

source.description: Source domain to match, e.g. "grants.gov" or "sam.gov".

status.description: Opportunity status (default: "active", meaning open, rolling and forecast; "all" includes closed).

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.
